title: Discovering like a scientist: Literature-informed dimensionless learning for physical closure of data-driven equations
summary: The method fits a unified trajectory equation to experimental wetting measurements and reports generalization across held-out liquids and initial volumes. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
